item.title: HiddenLayer nabs $100M as enterprises rush to secure their AI deployments
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: HiddenLayer has raised a $100M Series B from Delta-v Capital, Ten Eleven Ventures, Morgan Stanley, Microsoft's M12, Booz Allen Hamilton, and others.

item.title: PSA: Amazon’s shopping AI can now tell you if that message is a scam
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Amazon is adding a scam-detection feature to Alexa for Shopping that can verify whether suspicious emails, texts, and other messages actually came from the retailer.

item.title: Adobe acquires Indian market intelligence startup Rilo
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: This is Adobe's second acquisition out of India after Rephrase.ai in 2023

item.title: OpenAI faces 30 more lawsuits tied to Tumbler Ridge shooting
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Edelson PC is filing 30 new lawsuits against OpenAI over the Tumbler Ridge shooting, escalating claims to aiding and abetting and naming Chris Lehane, though evidence remains unconfirmed.

item.title: AfterQuery reportedly becomes Y Combinator’s fastest-ever unicorn, now valued at $3.2B
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: AI model-training startup AfterQuery has reportedly raised a round that valued it at $3.2 billion, just five months after announcing its $30 million Series A at a $300 million valuation in April.

item.title: OpenAI’s Astra model is on the way — and very good at breaking into computer systems
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: OpenAI previewed the precautions it is taking as it prepares to release Astra, its newest, cyber-critical LLM.

item.title: Google’s Android update tackles motion sickness, accessibility, and more
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: While some of the features see Google playing catch-up to Apple, which already offers similar features for iPhone users, others specifically leverage Gemini to provide various improvements.

item.title: Anthropic’s new Fable release is cheaper, less restrictive
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Fable 5.1 includes changes meant to reduce token cost and false-positive restrictions from the model's safeguards.

item.title: Google’s answer to Canva is an AI tool where you prompt instead of design
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: With Google Pics, Google is pushing deeper into the creative software market dominated by Canva and Adobe, but with a distinctly AI-first approach.

item.title: ChatGPT Health adds Epic integration for clinicians to import patient data
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: OpenAI said that the integration provides read-only access to health records for clinicians.

item.title: Sequoia-incubated Empirik launches with $21M to predict outages before they happen
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The startup wants to do for IT infrastructure what Cursor did for software engineering.

item.title: Amazon Alexa can now alert you when something new might tempt you to shop
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Amazon is adding a new Alexa-powered feature called “Update Me When” that can send personalized alerts about product launches, tours, books, shows, and other events that could trigger a purchase.

item.title: AIR raises $50M to help companies vet the skills and add-ons AI agents use
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: AIR's platform can discover agents running at a company, continuously vets any skills and add-ons they use, and blocks any unwanted behavior.

item.title: Fambot introduces an ‘AI chief of staff’ for families
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Fambot is building an AI “chief of staff” to help families manage the emails, calendars, school updates, sports schedules, and other logistics of raising kids.

item.title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.

item.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.

item.title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: As frustration over AI influencers has been growing, Instagram is limiting the reach of undisclosed AI profiles.

item.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Blue Voice is trained on department-specific laws, local ordinances, protocols, and guidelines that general-purpose AI tools can't access on the public internet.

item.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
item.dc:creator: Kate Park
item.description: The three-year-old startup says it reached $15 million in ARR and profitability before raising its latest $15 million round.

item.title: Nvidia’s $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech’s AI chip buildout
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. The deal shows how Nvidia plans to stay essential to AI infrastructure as Big Tech begins to build its own AI chips.
